# netbox_service (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_service" "example" {
  name               = "ssh"
  virtual_machine_id = netbox_virtual_machine.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `device_id` (Number) Conflicts with `virtual_machine_id`.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) Conflicts with `device_id`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ports` (List of Number)
- `protocol` (String)
